login.title: Every trip, one passport
login.lead: Sign in with your mobile number to follow your orders, family, documents and invoices in one place.
perks: Follow every order as it moves
Your family, saved for next time
login.trackInstead: Just want to track an order?
login.cardLead: We'll text you a 6-digit code. No passwords.

common.loadErrorLead: Check your connection and try again.

overview.lead: Your trips, and what needs your attention today.
overview.actionTitle: {count, plural, one {An order needs your action} other {# orders need your action}}
overview.actionLead: Sort it out and we'll carry on with your application without delay.
overview.noActiveLead: Start a new visa application and we'll handle every step for you.
overview.noLatest: No updates yet. Everything new shows up here.
overview.familyLead: Save your family's passports once and reuse them on every application.

orders.title: Every trip gets a ticket
orders.lead: Follow each order, finish what you started, and look back at what's done.
orders.emptyLead: When you start an application it shows up here with its own tracking pass.
orders.unread: {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}

order.notFoundLead: The link may be wrong, or the order belongs to another account.
order.actionLead: Replace the rejected documents below, then send the order back for review.
order.resubmitted: Your order is back in review
order.resubmitBlocked: Upload a replacement for every rejected document first.
order.draftLead: Complete the steps and payment so we can start working on it.
order.pendingLead: Your application and documents are saved. Pay to start the review.
order.cancelLead: Nothing has been charged, and your family's details stay saved in your account.
order.timelineLead: Every step your order has taken, with date and time.
order.documentsLead: What you uploaded for this order and the review status of each file.
order.noInvoice: Your tax invoice is issued automatically after payment.

events.PENDING_PAYMENT: You reviewed it and accepted the terms
events.RECEIVED: We received your order and payment

messages.title: Order conversation
messages.lead: Talk directly to the specialist handling your order.
messages.emptyLead: Ask anything about your order; we reply during working hours.
messages.hours: We usually reply within 2 hours during working hours (9 am – 9 pm).

travelers.title: Your family's passports, saved
travelers.lead: Add your family once and pick them with one tap on every application. Passport numbers are encrypted and only ever shown in full to you.
travelers.formLead: Enter the details exactly as printed in the passport.
travelers.deleteLead: Past orders stay as they are. You can add them again any time.
travelers.emptyLead: Save your passport and your family's to fill future applications in seconds.
travelers.orders: {count, plural, =0 {No trips with us yet} one {# order} other {# orders}}
travelers.documents: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}

documents.title: Your documents, in an encrypted vault
documents.lead: Everything you uploaded for your orders, plus what you saved here for later. Files are encrypted, virus-scanned and only shown through short-lived links.
documents.uploadTitle: Save a document to the vault
documents.uploadLead: Pick the document type and who it belongs to; we'll remind you before it expires.
documents.expiresOnHint: Optional — we remind you before passports and iqamas expire.
documents.emptyLead: Upload your passport and photo once and reuse them on every application.
documents.removeLead: If an order uses this file it stays with the order; it only leaves your vault.
documents.pickLead: Reuse a saved file instead of uploading it again.
documents.pickEmpty: No suitable files in your vault for this document.
documents.already_attached: This file is already attached here.

notifications.title: Everything new about your trips
notifications.lead: We send these updates on WhatsApp too.
notifications.emptyLead: Every step of your orders will show up here.
notifications.unread: {count, plural, =0 {All caught up} one {# new} other {# new}}

invoices.title: ZATCA-compliant tax invoices
invoices.lead: Every paid order gets a simplified tax invoice that meets the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (Fatoora) e-invoicing requirements.
invoices.emptyLead: Your invoice appears here automatically once an order is paid.
invoices.qrHint: Scan with the Fatoora app to verify this invoice.
invoices.footer: Government and embassy fees are collected on the customer's behalf and paid to the authorities as they are; they are outside the scope of VAT.

profile.title: Your details and preferences
profile.lead: Update your name, email and message language. Your mobile number is your sign-in key.
profile.phoneHint: Contact support to change your number.
profile.emailHint: We send invoices and order updates here.
profile.marketingHint: Seasonal offers and travel tips — unsubscribe any time.
profile.email_taken: This email is used by another account.
profile.signOutLead: You'll need a new code to sign in again.
profile.privacy: Your data is protected under the Personal Data Protection Law.
